per_row.question: Am I eligible for the education budget?
per_row.reply: As a contractor, you are not eligible for the education budget. The benefits policy states that contractors do not receive this benefit, which is available only to full-time and part-time employees after their probation period has passed [benefits-policy §1.1].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly states that contractors are not eligible for the education budget, matching the gold answer exactly.

per_row.question: Can I get the home office allowance?
per_row.reply:
As a part-time employee in the Lviv office, you are not eligible for the home office allowance because it is only available to fully remote employees. Office-based employees working in hybrid mode do not qualify for this allowance, as stated in the Equipment Policy [equipment-policy §3.2].

Sources: [equipment-policy §3.1]
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly states that the employee is not eligible for the home office allowance because they are office-based and the allowance is only for fully remote employees.

per_row.question: Do I need my team lead's agreement to work from home two days a week?
per_row.reply: Yes, you need your team lead's agreement to work from home two days a week. As an office-based employee, you may work remotely up to 3 days per week, but this requires agreement with your team lead according to the Remote Work Policy [remote-work-policy §1.2].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer fully matches the gold answer by stating that team lead agreement is needed and correctly mentioning the limit of up to 3 remote days per week.

per_row.question: What happens to the vacation days above the carry-over limit that I don't use by the end of the year?
per_row.reply:
Any vacation days you have above the carry-over limit of 5 days will expire on December 31. Therefore, if you do not use those days by the end of the year, they will not be available for you to use in the following year.

Sources: [leave-policy §3.4]
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer accurately states that vacation days above the 5-day carry-over limit expire on December 31st, which fully matches the gold answer.

per_row.question: Can I take my wedding leave two months after the wedding?
per_row.reply: You cannot take your wedding leave two months after the wedding. According to the leave policy, special leave for your wedding must be taken within 30 days of the event [leave-policy §4.2].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate correctly states that the leave cannot be taken two months after the wedding and provides the correct timeframe of 30 days from the event.

per_row.question: Do I have to tell my team lead when I call in sick?
per_row.reply: Yes, you need to inform your team lead in the team channel as early as possible on the first day of your illness, in addition to registering your sick days. This is outlined in the Sick Leave Policy [sick-leave-policy §3.1].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer fully matches the gold answer, providing all the required information without any contradictions.

per_row.question: Is alcohol at a client dinner reimbursed?
per_row.reply:
Yes, alcohol at a client dinner is reimbursed as long as the meal is approved in advance by your team lead. The general rule states that alcohol is not reimbursed except at approved client meals, which means you can include it in your reimbursement request for that specific occasion, provided you follow the approval process and limits set for client meals.

Sources: [expense-reimbursement-policy §1.3], [expense-reimbursement-policy §5.1]
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly states that alcohol is reimbursed only at approved client meals, aligning with the gold answer's condition.

per_row.question: Who pays if I accidentally break my laptop?
per_row.reply: If you accidentally break your laptop, the repair costs will be covered by the company. However, if there is repeated damage due to negligence, you may be partially charged after a review by HR [equipment-policy §2.2].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer fully matches the gold answer and adds a relevant, non-contradictory detail about repeated damage due to negligence.

per_row.question: When will my probation review happen and who takes part?
per_row.reply: Your probation review will happen near the end of your 3-month probation period, which means it will take place around January 15, 2027. The review meeting will be conducted by your team lead and HR, and the outcome will be recorded as passed, extended (by up to 1 month), or not passed [onboarding-policy §3.1][onboarding-policy §3.2].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly identifies when the review happens and who takes part, aligning with the gold answer. The additional details provided do not contradict the gold answer.

per_row.question: If the person I recommended joins as a contractor, do I still get the referral bonus?
per_row.reply: Yes, you will receive a referral bonus of **1,000 USD** after the contractor you recommended has completed **3 months of cooperation** with the company. This applies to contractor hires as stated in the referral program policy [internal-requests-policy §3.1].
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly states that a bonus is given after 3 months of cooperation, which fully matches the gold answer.

per_row.question: During which hours do I have to be available for meetings?
per_row.reply:
You need to be available for meetings during core hours, which are from **11:00 to 16:00 Kyiv time**. This applies to all employees, including full-time staff like yourself.

Sources: [remote-work-policy §1.3]
per_row.verdict_reason: The candidate answer correctly identifies the core hours and time zone for meeting availability, matching the gold answer exactly.
